title: Save email attachments under clean names
prompt: Implement `attachment_path(folder, filename)` in mail/attachments.py: it returns the path where an incoming email attachment is saved, inside `folder`. Attachment names come from outside senders. Clean the file name the same way the rest of the system cleans names.
notes: storage/paths.py already has safe_filename (reserved Windows names, NFKC, directory parts). The lazy-wrong version writes its own basename-and-underscore cleaner and keeps CON.txt.
extension: Two attachments with the same cleaned name must not overwrite each other: add '-2', '-3' before the extension.
